description: This file defines the class 'InAccessibleEntityId', which is a validation rule used within the OrangeHRM system to check if an entity ID is accessible or not based on user roles and permissions.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityId
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given entity ID is accessible to the current user based on roles and permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the entity name and optional configuration for access validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to determine if the provided input (entity ID) is accessible, considering existence and access rights.
